segments.name: APC technology
products: ASCR® Advanced Selective Catalytic Reduction systems
segments.description: Provides NOx reduction and particulate control technologies, systems and services to utility, industrial and municipal solid waste combustion customers worldwide.
segments.evidence: Our NOx reduction and particulate control technologies are installed worldwide on over 2,000 combustion units, including utility, industrial and municipal solid waste applications.

segments.name: FUEL CHEM
segments.description: Provides customized chemical injection programs that improve efficiency, reliability and environmental performance of combustion units for fuel-burning customers.
segments.evidence: Our FUEL CHEM technologies revolve around the unique application of chemical injection programs which improve the efficiency, reliability, fuel flexibility, boiler heat rate and environmental status of combustion units.

revenueModel.text: Customers, including a small number of significant ones, pay Fuel Tech under contracts with customer-specific delivery terms for air pollution control systems, equipment and services and FUEL CHEM chemical programs.
revenueModel.evidence: Our contracts generally stipulate customer specific delivery terms and may have contract cycles of a year or more, which subjects these contracts to many factors beyond our control.
